source_refs.note: Exercise 10.1, Question 23 (book p. 278); the book prints no answers for Exercise 10.1; answers checked with sympy and the solution book

blocks.explanation:
Left par do cosines ka farq hai aur right par sine. Ghaur kijiye: \(2x\) aur \(6x\) ki average \(4x\) hai, jo right side ka angle hai. Yeh ishara hai ke sum-to-product formula lagana hai.
Find kya karna hai? \([0, 2\pi]\) mein solutions aur general solution.
Rule: \(\cos C - \cos D = -2\sin\frac{C+D}{2}\sin\frac{C-D}{2}\).
Plan: left side ko \(\sin 4x\) wale product mein badalna, sab ek taraf la kar \(\sin 4x\) common nikalna, aur dono factors hal karna.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\cos 2x - \cos 6x = \sin 4x\).
Maloom karna: \([0, 2\pi]\) mein solutions aur general solution.
Tareeqa: \(\cos C - \cos D = -2\sin\frac{C+D}{2}\sin\frac{C-D}{2}\), jahan \(C = 2x\), \(D = 6x\). Is formula ke shuru wale minus ko yaad rakhna zaroori hai.

Difference formula lagayein
\[\cos 2x - \cos 6x = -2\sin 4x\sin(-2x)\]
\[= 2\sin 4x\sin 2x\]
Kyun: \(\frac{C+D}{2} = \frac{8x}{2} = 4x\) aur \(\frac{C-D}{2} = \frac{-4x}{2} = -2x\). Sine odd function hai: \(\sin(-\theta) = -\sin\theta\). Do minus mil kar plus ban gaye.
Dhyan dein: yeh sign bhool gaye to \(\sin 2x = -\frac{1}{2}\) aayega aur saare angles ghalat ho jayenge.

Factorise karein
\[2\sin 4x\sin 2x - \sin 4x = 0\]
\[\sin 4x(2\sin 2x - 1) = 0\]
\[\sin 4x = 0 \text{ ya } \sin 2x = \tfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: right side wala \(\sin 4x\) left par le aaye aur common nikala. \(\sin 4x\) se divide karna mana hai, warna \(\sin 4x = 0\) wale nau jawab gum ho jate.
Yeh wohi tareeqa hai jo Q22 mein kiya tha: jo function dono taraf maujood ho, usay common factor bana lo aur phir har factor ko zero rakho.

Jab \(\sin 4x = 0\)
\[4x = n\pi \;\Rightarrow\; x = \tfrac{n\pi}{4}\]
\([0, 2\pi]\) mein (\(n = 0, \ldots, 8\)):
\[0, \tfrac{\pi}{4}, \tfrac{\pi}{2}, \tfrac{3\pi}{4}, \pi, \tfrac{5\pi}{4}, \tfrac{3\pi}{2}, \tfrac{7\pi}{4}, 2\pi\]
Kyun: sine \(\pi\) ke har multiple par zero hota hai; 4 se divide karne par qadam \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) ka hai, aur \(n = 8\) par \(2\pi\).

Jab \(\sin 2x = \frac{1}{2}\)
\[2x = \tfrac{\pi}{6} + 2n\pi \text{ ya } \tfrac{5\pi}{6} + 2n\pi\]
\[x = \tfrac{\pi}{12} + n\pi \text{ ya } \tfrac{5\pi}{12} + n\pi\]
\([0, 2\pi]\) mein: \(\frac{\pi}{12}, \frac{13\pi}{12}, \frac{5\pi}{12}, \frac{17\pi}{12}\).
Kyun: sine positive hai to pehla (I) aur doosra (II) quadrant, reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{6}\); doosre quadrant ka angle \(\pi - \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{5\pi}{6}\). Phir 2 se divide kiya.

Saare jawab ikatthe karein
\[\left\{\tfrac{n\pi}{4}\right\} \cup \left\{\tfrac{\pi}{12} + n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\tfrac{5\pi}{12} + n\pi\right\}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{3\pi}{12}\), to \(\frac{n\pi}{4}\) mein numerators 0, 3, 6, 9, ... (12 ke denominator par) hain; \(\frac{\pi}{12}\) aur \(\frac{5\pi}{12}\) in mein nahi aate. Is liye koi value dohrai nahi gayi: \(9 + 4 = 13\) values.

Tasdeeq: \(x = \frac{\pi}{12}\)
\[\cos\tfrac{\pi}{6} - \cos\tfrac{\pi}{2} = \tfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} - 0 = \tfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
\[\sin\tfrac{\pi}{3} = \tfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(2x = \frac{\pi}{6}\), \(6x = \frac{\pi}{2}\), \(4x = \frac{\pi}{3}\) rakhe; dono taraf ek hi number aaya.
Chahein to \(x = \frac{\pi}{4}\) bhi check kar lein: \(\cos\frac{\pi}{2} - \cos\frac{3\pi}{2} = 0\) aur \(\sin\pi = 0\), dono barabar.
blocks.final_answer:
\([0, 2\pi]\) mein (13 values): \(x = 0, \frac{\pi}{12}, \frac{\pi}{4}, \frac{5\pi}{12}, \frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{3\pi}{4}, \pi, \frac{13\pi}{12}, \frac{5\pi}{4}, \frac{17\pi}{12}, \frac{3\pi}{2}, \frac{7\pi}{4}, 2\pi\)
General solution \(= \left\{\frac{n\pi}{4}\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{\pi}{12} + n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{5\pi}{12} + n\pi\right\}\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 10.1 ke jawab chhape hue nahi hain. Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. Is liye aap apna jawab yahan wale jawab se mila kar dekh sakte hain.
